name: Wànxiàng zhī jìng
source:
The story takes place in a fictional Taisho era. One ordinary evening, the protagonist and her junior, Yu, discover a strange mirror in the library. Where did the mirror come from? What secrets lie behind it? You will find out for yourself…

[Translated from [url=https://gorogorostudio.itch.io/themirrordemo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个架空的大正时代。某个平凡的傍晚，主人公与后辈Yu在图书馆里发现了一面不可思议的镜子。这面镜子究竟从何而来？镜子背后又隐藏着怎样的秘密？一切皆待你亲自揭晓……

[译自[url=https://gorogorostudio.itch.io/themirrordemo]itch.io[/url]]
